gate_results.gate_id: D2-006-G5: Cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL

observations: RETROSPECTIVE: this report was authored after execution as part of WP-6c. Metrics are transcribed from DEC-0009 and the H-009 trial_log entry. H-009 produced negative full-period Sharpe of -0.16384370990793867, max drawdown of 925.1630%, 2148 trades, positive gross PnL of 15592.0, and cost drag of 864.96% of gross PnL. The strategy failed 6 of 8 D2-006 gates because the multi-timeframe filter was too permissive to reduce 30m turnover and cost drag, and DEC-0009 archived the candidate as a baseline NO-GO. Max-drawdown and cost-drag values are under pre-WP-5b pipeline semantics; per WP-5a/WP-5b audit conclusions the overall NO-GO verdict is unaffected by later pipeline fixes.
diagnostic_findings: The multi-timeframe alignment filter did not provide enough selectivity to overcome the 30m cost-drag failure mode from H-006.
Gross PnL was positive, but fees and slippage produced total costs that were 8.6496 times gross PnL.
The 1h and 4h alignment filter permitted entries on roughly 78% of bars, making it nearly as permissive as no filter.
Parameter sensitivity showed extreme instability, with nearby variants flipping Sharpe sign.
H-006 and H-009 together exhausted two 30m hypothesis cycles, supporting the Cold Storage status noted in project_status.md.
